arguments.decision_needed: The tenant reports the LG washing machine (here when they moved in) has a power failure and, by their own googling, can't be fixed. They offer to buy a replacement at their own cost; it would remain theirs, not part of the property, and they would take it when they leave. Do you consent? arguments.body: Hi, thanks for letting us know about the washing machine. Fitting your own machine needs the landlord's consent, so we've asked them. We've noted that the new machine would stay yours and you'd take it with you when you leave. We've also asked who covers disconnecting the old one and fitting the new one, and what happens to the existing LG. Please don't remove or replace it until we confirm. If you can, send a photo of the machine and any error code. We'll update you by 30 July.
